svg.title: A tooling lane adds terminal diff validation and commit
svg.desc: Add terminal, diff, validation and commit as a distinct non-chat lane. Tooling artifacts must not be redrawn as conversational replies or an embodied assistant.

Tooling artifacts must not be redrawn as conversational replies or an embodied assistant.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.36060000000000003 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "terminal", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.536568, 0.1638, 0.196413 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "TERMINAL", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.744885, 0.1638, 0.086303 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.29525, 0.536568, 0.1638, 0.196413 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "DIFF", "label_box": [ 0.29525, 0.744885, 0.1638, 0.086303 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "checkmark", "box": [ 0.539179, 0.536568, 0.130942, 0.196413 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "VALIDATION", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.744885, 0.1638, 0.086303 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.75025, 0.536568, 0.1638, 0.196413 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "COMMIT", "label_box": [ 0.75025, 0.744885, 0.1638, 0.086303 ], "label_size": 18 } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** Curt adds a lane the diagram never had, and it does not look like the others.
No window, no chat, no reply. A terminal line, a diff, a validator's exit code, a commit
trailer. The register is the tooling surface, not a conversation.

**Action:** The apparatus acquires an author.

**Caption:**
> THE VALIDATORS. THE PAGE TOOL. THE CROSS REFERENCE. THE CHARACTER FILE THAT SAYS WHAT
> THIS PAGE MAY CLAIM.
>
> A SECOND MODEL WROTE THEM, UNDER A CONTRACT IT DID NOT WRITE.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — co-authorship is recorded commit by commit in
the repository's Git history and in [`CREDITS.md`](../../CREDITS.md). That this is the
situation of every agent in the first half of the book is the project's observation and is
not drawn as one.

", "title": "A tooling lane adds terminal diff validation and commit" } }
